_meta.comment: Active and upcoming in-game events. Times in server time (UTC+8) unless noted; end dates from community coverage are estimates — mark timeNote accordingly.

events.description: Limited-time combat event: clear waves of enemies with special bonuses. Ends ~16 days before Version 3.7 closes — finish it early.
events.name: Artisan's Search
events.timeNote: Exact daily boundary (03:59) from official Version 3.7 patch notes; reward totals from community coverage.

events.description: Leisure event with Encore and the Second Coming of Solaris: stage Cubie battles with magical items on the Wooly Stage.
events.name: Cubie Wars
events.timeNote: Dates/times from the official Version 3.7 patch notes as reported by coverage; verify in-game.

events.description: Area exploration event: uncover the Heart Realms of the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou and follow the stories of its people.
events.name: Dreams in the Capsule
events.timeNote: Dates from the official Version 3.7 patch notes as reported by coverage; verify in-game.

events.description: 7-day login event during Version 3.7: log in daily to claim that day's reward from the event page.
events.name: Gifts of Waking Moon
events.timeNote: Dates from the official Version 3.7 patch notes as reported by coverage; verify in-game.

events.name: Back to Solaris
events.timeNote: End date from the official Version 3.7 patch notes (2026-11-11 23:59 UTC+8); start date is an estimate — verify in-game.

events.description: Photo collection event: Hsin has arranged a task for Suoming — join her to record the sights of the Simulacrum Nexus of Mengzhou and draw out the long-sealed memories of the Ten Seals Covenant.
events.name: Past Dreams, Traced Seals
events.timeNote: Permanently available after the 3.7 update, per the official patch notes.

events.description: Login events across Version 3.7: Gifts of Waking Moon 7-day login (Sep 30 – Nov 11) plus Gifts of Singing Drizzle (Oct 22 – Nov 11) — see those entries for verified reward details. Community coverage also reports extra Lustrous Tides in the early weeks.
events.name: Version 3.7 Login Events
events.rewards: Radiant Tides, Lustrous Tides (per community coverage)
events.timeNote: Reward counts from community coverage (gurugamer.com); verified entries below carry official details.

events.description: Spending milestone track. At the 980-ring tier, pick one of Carlotta, Shorekeeper, or Phoebe. Not a substitute for a featured Convene, but valuable for accounts missing a universal support or Glacio DPS.
events.name: Moonlit Path (returns)
events.timeNote: Details from leak/community coverage; verify the milestone track in-game before spending.

events.description: Permanent event added in Version 3.7. No expiry — work through it at your own pace.
events.name: Blooms for the Shadow

events.description: Limited-time double leveling material drops. Short one-week window.
events.name: Bountiful Crescendo
events.timeNote: Dates from Game8's event schedule; exact start time verify in-game.

events.description: Web event: a mysterious stall appears at the Waking Moon Festival — take on the fishing challenge, unlock Fishing Index entries for Astrites, and complete event tasks for Advanced Sealed Tubes.
events.name: Waking Moon Fishing
events.rewards: Astrite, Advanced Sealed Tubes, event items
events.timeNote: Times from the official Version 3.7 patch notes (2026-10-15 10:00 – 2026-11-01 09:59 UTC+8).

events.description: Leisure event from the Second Coming of Solaris: move Echo Pieces around the board to clear matching echoes and recharge Resonator skills.
events.name: Echo Erase
events.timeNote: Dates/times from the official Version 3.7 patch notes as reported by coverage; verify in-game.

events.description: Cumulative login event starting with Phase 2: log in 1 day total for Radiant Tide x5 + Premium Tuner x100; 3 days total for Radiant Tide x5 + Crystal Solvent x5 (10 Radiant Tides total).
events.name: Gifts of Singing Drizzle
events.rewards: 10 Radiant Tides, 100 Premium Tuner, 5 Crystal Solvent
events.timeNote: Reward breakdown from the official Version 3.7 patch notes as reported by coverage; verify in-game.

events.description: Featured exploration event: complete daily event tasks to obtain Adventure Logs, then exchange each log for an Adventure Package.
events.name: Beyond the Waves: Land of Xuanfang
events.rewards: Astrite, Lustrous Tide, Crystal Solvent, Premium Tuner, event materials (per Game8 guide)
events.timeNote: Dates from the official Version 3.7 patch notes as reported by coverage; verify in-game.

events.description: Limited-time double Echo and Echo leveling material drops for the final week of the patch.
events.name: Chord Cleansing
events.rewards: Double Echo drops, double Echo leveling materials
events.timeNote: Dates from Game8's event schedule; verify in-game.

events.description: Official community contest: create a Wuthering Waves combat video and post it publicly on X, YouTube Shorts, or TikTok with #WutheringWaves and #WuwaBattle. Headline prize is Astrite x2,000; 10 extra winners receive $50 Amazon Gift Cards.
events.name: Battle Rush (community contest)
events.rewards: Astrite x2,000 (main winners), $50 Amazon Gift Card (10 extra winners)
events.timeNote: Covered by earlygg.com; confirm the rules on the official announcement before entering.

events.description: Recurring character-trial event: test the current 3.7 featured Resonators in dedicated trial stages. Each completed trial grants Astrite plus upgrade materials. Phase 1 trials (Hsin, Chisa, Iuno, Buling, Youhu, Taoqi) refresh for the Phase 2 lineup (Suoming, Lynae, Lucilla, Lumi, Chixia, Danjin) at the banner flip.
events.name: Ascendant Aces
events.rewards: Astrite x20 per trial, Advanced/Medium Resonance Potions, Energy Cores, Shell Credits (claimable once per trial Resonator)
events.timeNote: Sep 30 - Nov 11 per Game8's event guide and event schedule; unlocked by default, no Union Level requirement.
